We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the reaction: deprotection of TBS protecting group from an alcohol. The forward reaction: alcohol + TBDMSCl -> TBS-protected alcohol (O-Si bond formed). The reverse (retrosynthesis) we need to break O-Si bond, forming free alcohol and TBS group (maybe TBDMSCl). The template likely involves breaking O-Si bond and forming aliphatic hydroxyl functional group.

We need to search template catalog with criteria: bonds broken: O-Si (maybe "6-14"? Not sure). functional groups broken: "t-butyldimethylsilyl". functional groups formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

We need to provide target molecule SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to specify criteria. Let's try functional_groups_broken: "t-butyldimethylsilyl". functional_groups_formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". bonds_broken: maybe "O-Si". Not sure format. Use "O-Si". Let's try.
